title: Why sitting is bad for health?

vocabulary.meaning: a way of life involving long periods of sitting and little physical activity
examples: The article gave a clear example of sedentary lifestyle.
We discussed sedentary lifestyle during the session.

vocabulary.meaning: the position in which a person holds their body while sitting, standing, or moving
examples: Many people have strong opinions about posture.
Understanding posture helped me follow the discussion.

vocabulary.meaning: the movement of blood around the body
examples: Circulation was one of the key ideas in the article.
I used the term circulation when explaining my opinion.

vocabulary.meaning: a lack of enough movement or exercise for good health
examples: The speaker described how physical inactivity can affect people's lives.
Our group talked about the advantages and disadvantages of physical inactivity.

vocabulary.meaning: reduced strength in one or more muscles
examples: The discussion made me think more carefully about muscle weakness.
Different countries may have different experiences with muscle weakness.

vocabulary.meaning: the health of the heart and blood vessels
examples: I had heard of cardiovascular health before, but I did not fully understand it.
After the lesson, I could explain cardiovascular health in my own words.
